x-openregister._seedDataNote: Seed objects MOVED to lib/Settings/profiles/*.json (OpenSpec change seed-profiles). A register.d fragment declares SCHEMAS ONLY, so installing this app plants zero objects. The examples that used to live here are now part of an example set an operator picks in the first-time setup wizard, which is the only thing that imports them.

Decision.description: Additive delta (ADR-037 fragment-located additive pattern; OpenSpec urgent-decision-procedure). This fragment merges ONLY the four optional urgency properties (isUrgent, urgencyReason, urgencyDeclaredBy, urgencyDeclaredAt), one ratifying-stage aggregation, the awaitingRatification calculation, and two notification rules onto the existing decision schema. It adds NO required field and modifies NO existing property, aggregation, calculation, or notification: the register deep-merge (SettingsService:deepMergeConfig) unions these by key with the base schema, so decisions created before this change stay valid and the existing x-openregister-lifecycle transition map is untouched (urgency is orthogonal to lifecycle, exactly like isPublished). Version bumped to 0.8.0 (the sibling governing-documents fragment sets 0.7.0; ONE fragment wins the scalar version: this one uses the higher number). CONDITIONAL/GUARDED RULES are SAVE-TIME imperative, NOT schema constraints (no allOf/anyOf/oneOf in an OR register schema): urgencyReason is required when isUrgent is true (enforced by the trigger flow); the urgency fields are writable ONLY through the guarded urgency-trigger endpoint and rejected on direct object update (same posture as isPublished); every write path carries the urgency fields forward (saveObject is PUT-semantic). See design.md seams A/B and Task 3.

isUrgent.title: Urgent
isUrgent.description: Whether this decision has been declared urgent (spoedbesluit). Orthogonal to lifecycle/outcome/isPublished: no lifecycle state or transition is added. Additive optional field. Server-guarded: settable ONLY through the guarded urgency-trigger flow (UrgencyTriggerGuard, imperative seam A), rejected on a direct object update, the same field-guard posture as isPublished. Because saveObject is PUT-semantic, every decision write path MUST carry this forward.

urgencyReason.title: Urgency reason
urgencyReason.description: Free-text justification for the urgency declaration (the statutory/urgency basis, e.g. a Gemeentewet college spoedbevoegdheid or an articles-of-association urgent-resolution clause). CONDITIONALLY REQUIRED when isUrgent is true: enforced save-time by the trigger flow, not by a JSON Schema constraint (OR rejects allOf/anyOf/oneOf). Stored verbatim (length-validated on input, escaped on output). Defaults the emergency meeting's noticeDeviationReason.
urgencyReason.example: Acute opvangcrisis; eerstvolgende reguliere raadsvergadering is pas over drie weken (Gemeentewet-spoedbevoegdheid college).

urgencyDeclaredBy.title: Urgency declared by
urgencyDeclaredBy.description: Nextcloud user id of the actor who declared the urgency (resolved and stored by the trigger guard). Not a Person/participant reference: a uid string for audit attribution; no kind:field notification recipient references it (recipient rule).

urgencyDeclaredAt.title: Urgency declared at
urgencyDeclaredAt.description: Timestamp at which the urgency was declared (set by the trigger flow). Additive optional field.

urgentDecisionDeclared._note: decidesk-notifications delta (urgent-decision-procedure). Canonical x-openregister-notifications dialect (ADR-031), verified keys only: trigger.type 'updated' with a condition on isUrgent equals true, channels[], recipients[] via kind:object-acl (read) covering readers of the deciding and ratifying bodies + kind:groups (decidesk-members). kind:field is NOT used on any non-uid property (never urgencyDeclaredBy). A precise per-body-membership recipient form is deferred (same deferral posture as the base lifecycle-entered trigger). Decidiq dispatches no notification imperatively.

urgentRatificationDue._note: decidesk-notifications delta (urgent-decision-procedure). Verified scheduled dialect (mirrors Meeting.meetingReminder): trigger.type 'scheduled', intervalSec 86400 (daily; >= 60), filter on the materialised awaitingRatification field equals true so reminders fire only while ratification is outstanding and stop once the ratifying stage is decided (awaitingRatification derives false). Recipients via kind:object-acl (read) + kind:groups (decidesk-members); no kind:field on any non-uid property.

Meeting.description: Additive delta (ADR-037; OpenSpec urgent-decision-procedure, meeting-management delta). Merges ONLY three optional shortened-notice deviation properties (shortenedNotice, actualNoticeHours, noticeDeviationReason) onto the existing meeting schema for emergency (meetingType=extraordinary) convocations linked to an urgent decision's expedited procedure. No required field is added and no existing property, lifecycle, or notification is modified. The existing convocation flow (per-recipient delivery tracking, notice arithmetic, 3-day warning) is unchanged; this only records a deliberate deviation. GUARDED RULES are SAVE-TIME imperative (BoardMeetingService, Task 6), NOT schema constraints: the deviation path is exclusive to extraordinary meetings; the send is rejected when actualNoticeHours is below the governing body's urgencyPolicy.minimumNoticeFloorHours; noticeDeviationReason is required when shortenedNotice is true (defaulting to the decision's urgencyReason).

shortenedNotice.title: Shortened notice
shortenedNotice.description: True when this extraordinary meeting's convocation was deliberately sent below the body's regular notice period (noticePeriodDays) for an urgent decision. Additive optional field; exclusive to meetingType=extraordinary (enforced save-time). The pre-send overdue hint (noticeRules) presents a recorded deviation as a deliberate shortened-notice state, not an error.

actualNoticeHours.title: Actual notice (hours)
actualNoticeHours.description: The notice actually given, in hours, at convocation send time. Recorded on a shortened-notice deviation. The send is rejected save-time when this is below the governing body's urgencyPolicy.minimumNoticeFloorHours (Task 6, hour-granular floor sitting below the day-granular notice period).

noticeDeviationReason.title: Notice deviation reason
noticeDeviationReason.description: Reason the regular notice period could not be met. CONDITIONALLY REQUIRED when shortenedNotice is true (enforced save-time, not by a schema constraint), defaulting to the linked urgent decision's urgencyReason.
noticeDeviationReason.example: Spoedbesluit noodopvang — reguliere oproeptermijn niet haalbaar.

ProcessTemplate.description: Additive delta (ADR-037; OpenSpec urgent-decision-procedure, process-configuration delta). Merges ONLY the optional urgencyPolicy object onto the existing process-template schema (defined in 43-process-config-v1.json) so each governance body configures whether and how the urgent procedure is available. Fail-closed posture: a template with NO urgencyPolicy makes the urgent procedure UNAVAILABLE for its bodies, never available-with-no-limits. Server-side template validation (ProcessTemplateService, Task 2) rejects an urgencyPolicy with empty allowedTriggerRoles, an unrecognised role token, min>max deadline bounds, or ratificationRequired=true without a resolvable ratifyingBody. SAVE-TIME imperative rules, NOT schema constraints (OR rejects allOf/anyOf/oneOf). Built-in templates stay read-only; urgency is enabled by duplicating and editing (see the two urgency-enabled custom seeds in this fragment).

urgencyPolicy.title: Urgency policy
urgencyPolicy.description: Per-template urgent-decision-procedure policy. Absent = the urgent procedure is unavailable for bodies assigned this template (fail closed). Validated save-time (fail-closed, mirroring the existing transition-graph validation).

allowedTriggerRoles.title: Allowed trigger roles
allowedTriggerRoles.description: Role tokens permitted to declare a decision urgent (e.g. chair, secretary, board-member). Must be non-empty and contain only recognised tokens (validated save-time). The trigger guard resolves the acting user against these roles and fails closed when none resolves.

minimumNoticeFloorHours.title: Minimum notice floor (hours)
minimumNoticeFloorHours.description: The shortest convocation notice, in hours, an emergency (extraordinary) meeting under this template may use. Integer >= 0. Sits below the day-granular noticePeriodDays without redefining it; a shortened-notice send below this floor is rejected.

responseDeadlineHours.title: Response deadline bounds (hours)
responseDeadlineHours.description: Inclusive bounds, in hours, on the expedited written-round response deadline. min > max is rejected save-time (HTTP 400 naming the inverted bounds). votingDeadline is date-time so hour granularity is lossless.

min.title: Minimum hours
min.description: Shortest permitted expedited-round response deadline, in hours.

max.title: Maximum hours
max.description: Longest permitted expedited-round response deadline, in hours.

ratificationRequired.title: Ratification required
ratificationRequired.description: Whether an urgent decision under this template must be routed to a mandatory ratifying stage. When true, ratifyingBody must resolve (else the save is rejected).

ratifyingBody.title: Ratifying body
ratifyingBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody that ratifies an urgent decision (overridable at trigger time). Required when ratificationRequired is true (validated save-time). Seed refs are stored by slug and mapped to UUID at import.
